functionDeclarations.name: lml_chat
functionDeclarations.description: Get cross-domain taste recommendations from Like Me Like via natural language. Returns a text reply plus a structured recommendations array. Use this for any question of the form 'recommend me X based on Y' across films, books, music, food, places, etc.

locale.description: BCP-47 locale, e.g. 'en' or 'nl'. Drives reply language.

liked_items.description: 1-5 items the end-user has explicitly loved. Highest-impact signal. Each entry: {title, category?}.

display_name.description: End-user's first name or handle (max 40 chars). The brain will address them by this name.

gift_mode.description: True when the recommendation is for someone else (gift, friend, child).

functionDeclarations.name: lml_recommend_scoped
functionDeclarations.description: Get a single recommendation in a specific category, given a seed item the user loves. Use when the user explicitly asks for one pick in one category (e.g. 'one book based on Interstellar').

item.description: Seed item title or short description.

target_category.description: Target category id (book / movie / song / food / place / ...).

functionDeclarations.name: lml_disambiguate
functionDeclarations.description: Resolve an ambiguous title (e.g. 'Dune' could mean the 1965 novel, the 2021 film, or the video game) to ranked candidates from the items catalog. Use BEFORE recommend_* when the seed could match multiple things.

category_hint.description: Optional category id to bias confidence.
